# L1 — Causal

**MEF lens `L1`** · Square B — Encounter `[1 + 4]`: cause ⇄ experience, structure ⇄ investigation · Day face · index `#1` · tonic `D` · ground-pair **Mind/Need** (Name-led) · twin: [L1′ — Phenomenal](L1-prime-phenomenal.md)

*Root:* Aristotle, Icchā Śakti, Schopenhauer · *Key concept:* will as causal force; four causes · *Element:* Earth · *Möbius:* `L1 → L4′`

Grounds on first-apprehension (Mind) over constitutive lack (Need): causation read as the needful mind tracing *why*. Anchor index 1, so the rotation begins at Mind and closes on Truth/Play (the free will).

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L1.0 — Svātantrya** (`Mind[D]` / `Need[D♯]`) — the meta-causal ground; absolute freedom, the *capacity* to cause. Why is there causation at all?

- **L1.1 — Material cause** (`Word[E]` / `Sacrifice[F]`) — that-out-of-which, the *hyle*; mapped to Sensation, raw givenness.

- **L1.2 — Efficient cause** (`Logos[F♯]` / `Decision[G]`) — that-by-which, the transforming force; mapped to Feeling. Science's privileged but partial cause.

- **L1.3 — Formal cause** (`Son[G♯]` / `Love[A]`) — the what-it-is, the *eidos*; mapped to Thinking. Every law is a formal cause.

- **L1.4 — Final cause** (`Image[A♯]` / `Work[B]`) — that-for-the-sake-of-which, the *telos*; mapped to Intuition; immanent and transcendent finality.

- **L1.5 — Icchā Śakti / Will** (`Truth[C]` / `Play[C♯]`) — the synthesis; the will underlying all four, Śiva's first movement, Schopenhauer's thing-in-itself. The free ground returning.


## Derivation at this index

*8-fold:* sounds Word·Logos·Son·Image + Sacrifice·Decision·Love·Work; anchors Mind, Truth, Need, Play. *Diatonic:* Mind–Word–Logos · Decision–Love–Work–Play.

*Reading:* grounded on Mind/Need, the four causes are the needful mind's tracing, resolving onto Truth/Play as ultimate will — the cross-helix offset is the will's first movement from Mind into Need.
